headline: Tech lifts market as geopolitical tensions weigh on commodities
deck: Nasdaq gains on AI strength while bonds rally and energy markets absorb Middle East uncertainty.
body:
Tech stocks drove today's modest gains, with the Nasdaq climbing 0.63% as AI-focused equities attracted investor interest despite broader market caution. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones both edged lower, suggesting a rotation into growth names rather than broad market conviction. Treasury yields fell 7 basis points to 4.94%, indicating demand for safe-haven assets amid persistent geopolitical concerns.

Middle East tensions continue to complicate the energy outlook. Ongoing conflict near the Strait of Hormuz has vessels trickling through at elevated costs, though oil prices slid today alongside the broader market weakness. Meanwhile, the global diesel shortage is expected to persist into 2027 as storage inventories drain, creating a structural supply challenge independent of immediate headlines.

International developments provided mixed signals for investor sentiment. Trade tensions between the US and China remain in focus as Xi prepares summit discussions, while German political uncertainty and Iran-US rhetoric add layers of geopolitical risk. Indian equities stabilized after recent losses, suggesting some stabilization in emerging markets despite the complex macro environment.
